$comment: Declared differences between docker-compose.yml and the console-shipped copy. Any other difference in a shared service fails the parity gate. reason states why the difference is allowed; drift entries are differences that should not exist and are printed on every run until they are fixed.

env_file.reason: The console writes its .env into the operator's studio dir and loads it per service; the repo compose expects the operator's own env.

volumes.reason: Same mounts, different host-side variable names: the repo uses SHS_WORKSPACE_HOST, the console splits storage into SHS_STORAGE_ROOT, SHS_DB_DATA and SHS_MODELS_ROOT.

environment.reason: The repo sets XDG_CACHE_HOME so whisper model files persist on the volume; the console copy has no model cache path yet.
HF_HOME points at the workspace volume in the repo and at the separate /models mount in the console; SHS_AUDIO_MODEL_IDLE_SECONDS is absent from the console copy.
